header.16..23: u64 little-endian start selector index inclusive
header.24..31: u64 little-endian end selector index exclusive

record.0..3: u32 little-endian selector index, NOT actual x

field_encoding: binary polynomial coefficient j is bit j; prime values canonical integers
ordering: selector index ascending, then y ascending; actual x is also ascending
point_policy: all affine lifts, both distinct signs; no infinity or subgroup filtering
receipt: part-NNNN.json gives counts, all-candidate verification, compressed/raw SHA256, coverage hash and sample actual coordinates
manifest: per-family manifest.json binds all128 receipts, exact domain, curve, point count, reuse m2..9; index.json is complete only after all384 shards
csv: factor_base csv SHARD LIMIT prints selector_index,x,y
retention: All completed and incomplete artifacts stay in fresh run prefixes; preserve baseline separately and never label partial index as complete.
